evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The assertion supplies a categorical distinction about control of intelligence as the governing fact, but performs no clear influence tactic.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: The contrast frames supplied facts to establish what is retained as the asset, making informational control the clearest power signal.
The speaker explicitly frames the utterance as a restatement of a thesis, supplying positioning through an informational claim rather than a direct influence attempt.
